column1: # Russian grammar words. One line per word as written + part of speech:
# word <TAB> UD part of speech <TAB> senses separated by " | ".
# The file replaces Wiktionary's determiner, pronoun, preposition, conjunction,
# particle and auxiliary entries for every word listed here; nouns, verbs,
# adverbs and other content words stay (всё "still", ничего "okay").
# Write the word with its stress mark, as the dump does (one-syllable words and
# words with ё need none): lookups ignore the mark, and the reader sees it.
# Write ё where the word has it: the importer also indexes the е spelling.
# A phrase with its own entry (так себе, тем более) is left to that entry,
# which lookups show first when the sentence contains it.
# A line with a content part of speech (здесь ADV) replaces Wiktionary's entry
# of that part of speech for the word; X lines (endings) only add.
# Irregular forms a reader can't connect to their base get lines of their own
# (был "was", будет "will be"): the protocol has no inflection tables.
